lede.zh: 这份报告记录 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next MXFP8-MTP 在 8×Ascend 950DT 上的固定长度、真实 coding 消息回放、图文请求与长上下文检索结果。最终 17 个测点全部完成；本地源码与算子适配是测试环境的一部分。
lede.en: This report measures Qwen3.8-Flash-Next MXFP8-MTP on 8×Ascend 950DT across fixed-length requests, coding-trace replay, image-text traffic, and long-context retrieval. All 17 final points completed; local source and operator adaptations are part of the tested stack.

snapshot.zh: 17 个正式测点 · 固定长度 / Agent 回放 / 图文 / 256K 与 512K
snapshot.en: 17 measured points · fixed length / Agent replay / image-text / 256K and 512K

stats.zhNote: C8 轮次完成 · 0 错误

heading.zh: 性能结论按负载类型分别读取
heading.en: Read each result in its workload context

intro.zh: 在固定 512 输出的合成文本负载下，C8 提高聚合输出吞吐，同时抬高 TTFT 和 TPOT。真实 coding 消息回放 C8 完成 437 轮，聚合吞吐 116.2 tok/s；它衡量的是服务行为，不是 coding 任务成功率。图文与长上下文数据独立测量。
intro.en: For synthetic text with a fixed 512-token output, C8 raises aggregate output throughput while increasing TTFT and TPOT. At C8, coding-trace replay completed 437 turns at 116.2 tok/s aggregate; this measures serving behavior, not coding task success. Image-text and long-context results are separate workloads.

note.zh: 最终批次使用 8,192 max-num-batched-tokens 和 QSA960 切分适配。8192 与历史 4096 配置的三次独立启动对照同时改变两个因素，不能归因于单一改动。长上下文仅是检索探测，512K 的 n=8 不支持尾延迟结论。
note.en: The final batch uses an 8,192 max-num-batched-tokens setting and a QSA960 splitting adaptation. The three-start comparison with the historical 4,096 configuration changes two factors together, so the effect cannot be attributed to one change. Long-context results are retrieval probes; n=8 at 512K does not support tail-latency claims.

heading.zh: 并发提高聚合吞吐，也增加单请求等待
heading.en: Concurrency raises aggregate throughput and per-request latency

intro.zh: 每点 128 请求，错误为 0；固定输出 512 token。吞吐为整批输出 token / 测量墙钟时间，单请求 decode 速率不与之混用。
intro.en: Each point has 128 requests and zero errors, with 512 output tokens. Aggregate throughput is output tokens divided by measurement wall time; it is distinct from per-request decode rate.

title.zh: 固定 512 输出的总输出吞吐
title.en: Aggregate output throughput at 512 output tokens

hint.zh: 按输入长度分组；悬停查看各并发测点。
hint.en: Grouped by input length; hover over points for concurrency results.

notes.zh: C8 总吞吐高于 C1，但 TTFT 与 TPOT 同时上升；这代表聚合容量与单请求响应之间的取舍。
notes.en: C8 increases aggregate throughput over C1 while both TTFT and TPOT rise, showing the trade-off between aggregate capacity and per-request response.

heading.zh: C8 回放吞吐升高，单轮延迟也明显增加
heading.en: C8 increases replay throughput and turn latency

intro.zh: 回放 16 个公开 coding 会话轨迹，按真实消息顺序将模型回复写入下一轮上下文；工具和环境消息使用录制内容，不执行新生成的工具动作。
intro.en: Sixteen public coding-session traces were replayed in message order, with model responses carried into subsequent turns. Tool and environment messages were replayed; generated tool actions were not executed.

title.zh: Agent 回放聚合输出吞吐
title.en: Aggregate output throughput during Agent replay

hint.zh: 服务吞吐指标，不代表任务成功率。
hint.en: Serving throughput only; this is not a task success score.

notes.zh: C1/C8 各 437 轮完成、错误为 0。分别有 9/3 条回复触及 512 token 上限；不据此声称任务完成或答案质量。
notes.en: All 437 turns completed at C1 and C8 with zero request errors. Nine and three responses respectively reached the 512-token cap; this does not establish task completion or answer quality.

heading.zh: 图文输入按图像 token 桶分别报告
heading.en: Image-text results are separated by image-token bucket

intro.zh: 两档图像 token 桶分别在 C1 与 C8 测量，每点 128 个固定 512 输出请求。处理器图像缓存热、解码器前缀缓存冷；不能与纯文本结果直接比较。
intro.en: Two image-token buckets were measured at C1 and C8, with 128 fixed 512-token outputs per point. The processor image cache was warm and decoder prefix cache cold; these results are not directly comparable to text-only points.

notes.zh: ChartQA 与 DocVQA 各 128 条固定公开子集的准确性结果属于单独质量检查，不作为性能分数；不是完整榜单评测。
notes.en: Accuracy checks on fixed public subsets of 128 ChartQA and 128 DocVQA items are separate from performance measurements and are not full benchmark leaderboard evaluations.

heading.zh: 256K 与 512K 检索点均完成，样本量较小
heading.en: 256K and 512K retrieval probes completed with small samples

intro.zh: 用 coding 文本中的合成检索键探测上下文窗口；这不是 Agent 历史长度或任务能力测试。输出约 20 token，C1。
intro.en: Synthetic retrieval keys embedded in coding text were used to probe context windows. These are not Agent-history or task-capability tests. Each C1 point generated about 20 tokens.

notes.zh: 128K、256K 与 512K 为检索探测，512K 使用独立 YaRN 扩窗配置；512K 本轮仅 3 个有效请求。1M 仅完成两条后被停止，第三条取消，不纳入已完成性能点。
notes.en: The 128K, 256K, and 512K points are retrieval probes; 512K uses a separate YaRN extended-window configuration and has only three valid requests in this run. The 1M run was stopped after two requests and a third was cancelled, so it is excluded.

meta.value: 17 completed points · text, replay, image-text, context
Fixed-length requests and sequential multi-turn trace replay

methodIntro.zh: 结果来自最终有效测试批次。服务配置、场景窗口和缓存状态分别记录；历史失效批次和不完整 1M 测点不并入正式结果。
methodIntro.en: Results use the final valid measurement batches. Serving configuration, workload windows, and cache states are reported separately; invalid historical batches and the incomplete 1M point are excluded.

methodNotes.zh: 固定文本与图文正式点每点 n=128；Agent 每个并发档 437 轮；长上下文和 32K/2048 探测仅 n=3–8。分位数仅在 n≥128 时展示，低样本点不推断尾延迟。
methodNotes.en: Fixed-text and image-text points use n=128 each; Agent replay has 437 turns per concurrency level; long-context and 32K/2048 probes use n=3–8. Percentiles are shown only for n≥128; no tail-latency claims are made from small samples.

methodNotes.zh: TPOT 为首包后解码阶段的请求平均间隔口径，不是单 token ITL。MTP 流式包可能含多个 token。报告未提供跨模型、跨权重或跨硬件归一化比较。
methodNotes.en: TPOT is a request-level average interval over the decode phase after the first packet, not per-token ITL. An MTP stream packet can contain multiple tokens. This report does not normalize results across models, checkpoints, or hardware.
